summary.en: The Philippines and France conducted a bilateral maritime exercise with the French Floréal class frigate FS Vendémiaire sailing alongside the Philippine guided-missile frigate BRP Diego Silang and the coast guard vessel BRP Sarangani. Finland and the Philippines discussed maritime security cooperation and signed a pact that includes Australian assistance for drones and cybersecurity. The Philippine Coast Guard increased its presence in Talisay and rescued 22 people from a distressed boat off Palawan. China and ASEAN countries continue to struggle over a South China Sea code of conduct, and 176 battle-related deaths were reported in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Filippinene og Frankrike gjennomførte en bilateral sjøøvelse med den franske fregatten FS Vendémiaire fra Floréal-klassen som seilte sammen med den filippinske missilfregatten BRP Diego Silang og kystvaktskipet BRP Sarangani. Finland og Filippinene diskuterte samarbeid om maritim sikkerhet og signerte en avtale som inkluderer australsk bistand til droner og cybersikkerhet. Filippinernes kystvakt økte sin tilstedeværelse i Talisay og reddet 22 personer fra en nødstilt båt utenfor Palawan. Kina og ASEAN-landene fortsetter å kjempe om en kode for oppførsel i Sør-Kina-havet, og 176 dødsfall i kamp ble rapportert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
